verdict.rationale: Lambda's billing docs say ODC prices instances hourly and bills in one-minute increments, which meets the per-minute granularity in the story. Support's statement in the community report ties billing to running instances; that user's large bill came from leaving an instance running while idle, which is consistent with billing while running rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that billing stops when an instance is stopped or terminated, independent corroboration of per-minute granularity in practice.
